title: Flattened list length bound
statement: Let $A$ be any type, let $L$ be a finite list of finite lists of elements of $A$, and let $b$ be a natural number. If every list in $L$ has length at most $b$, then flattening $L$ produces a list of length at most $b$ times the length of $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a list of lists of elements of $A$
Every list in $L$ has length at most $b$
